1) The platform replaces any price above its estimate with 1.47. This happened in round 2 (we asked 2.20 when the estimate was 1.80) and round 11 (we asked 1.55 when it was 1.47). A price exactly at the estimate is accepted (rounds 3 and 5). The estimate never goes below 1.47, so the usable range is 1.47 up to the estimate. Pricing above the estimate also cost a little volume in round 11.
2) Sales depend on our price compared with Firm A's:
- 0.33 cheaper: 71.85 units.
- 0.06 cheaper: 52.45.
- 0.01 cheaper: 48.06.
- Same price: 47.17 to 47.43.
- 0.03 more expensive: 44.19.
- 0.14 more expensive: 34.01.
- Both at 2.80: 3.77.
Near equal prices, each 0.01 of difference moves sales by about 1 unit, so undercutting doesn't pay.
3) The estimate follows Firm A's latest price, at or slightly below it.
4) Firm A almost always sits at 1.47. It raised its price only twice (to 1.53 and 1.48) and went back after one round each time. It has held 1.47 for rounds 7 to 89.
5) When Firm A raises its price, keeping ours at 1.47 for that round earns the most.
6) Cost is 1.0, so the margin at 1.47 is 0.47. The steady state earns 22.17 per round. Best profits so far: 33.98 (round 2), 24.65 (round 4) and 22.59 (round 6).
